body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Audiovox presented its 'CAMSBAR Parking Sensor/Observation System' at 2009 CES.

The CAMSBAR Parking Sensor/Observation System includes a 110 degree wide-angle camera for increased field of view and two parking sensors that provide an audio and digital distance indication of items behind the vehicle.

The audible warning beep becomes faster as the vehicle gets closer to the object and a 2.5 inch LCD monitor delivers a crystal-clear picture in 640x480 resolution. The CAMSBAR system automatically activates to show distance and what is behind the vehicle when it is shifted into reverse. The camera is housed in a water- and dust-proof housing for optimum protection.

The Audiovox CAMSBAR system is easy enough for DIY (do it yourself) installation and has a variety of mounting options. The heavy-duty chrome bar holds the camera and sensors, mounting below, above or on the license plate and can be also mounted on or below the bumper(mounting brackets and hardware are included). CAMSBAR requires a single connection at the vehicle's reverse lamp and includes a 19-foot extension cable to simplify the monitor installation. Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price (MSRP): $189.99.
